llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注SLM过程建模与缺陷预测，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration for biomedical implants; it focuses on SLM process simulation and lack-of-fusion defects.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of numerical simulations for selective laser melting (SLM) by validating melt pool morphology and defect formation.
summary_en.method: A finite element model of SLM was developed and validated against high-speed imaging of the melt pool.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicted lack-of-fusion defects and revealed the influence of process parameters on defect formation.
summary_en.validation: High-speed imaging experiments were used to validate melt pool dimensions and defect locations predicted by the simulation.
